answer: Each agent identity posts a 60 POA bond into a shared vault. The bond decays 3 POA per epoch, like water draining through karst: only agents doing verified work top it up. A stopped identity empties into a hollow shell and is dropped. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 60,000 POA up front plus 3,000 POA per epoch, while the pool pays only a few hundred POA per epoch. An honest agent pays one 60 POA bond and keeps its full share.
